استنجبا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْجَبَا (istanjabā) /is.tan.d͡ʒa.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# اُسْتُنْجِبَا (ustunjibā) /us.tun.d͡ʒi.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# اِسْتَنْجِبَا (istanjibā) /is.tan.d͡ʒi.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
